provenance.gold_sql: SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?

provenance.evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';
provenance.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

question: Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
